sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Review of the grammar and language systems from Units 1–9.

Szia works as both 'hi' and 'bye' between people who'd use te with each other — context is all that tells them apart. And táskád keeps the pattern going: -d marks 'your' directly on the noun, just like -m marks 'my' and -a/-ja marks 'his/her'.
